answer: Each identity must post a 500-token bond and pass a work proof whose solution seeds a per-device key, with the registry stamping a tide value on every submission to track reuse. A forged identity locks 500 tokens and forfeits 100% of them plus the work proof on detection, waiting two epochs for reclaim. Copying an identity costs another 500-token bond, and independent jurors slash both copies at 100%, so the gale of fake registrations gains no haven from splitting.
